2836.title: Thread continuation does not create child threads
2836.rootCauseOneLine: The CLI and app create normal threads because neither path puts the current source thread into parentThreadId.
2836.proposedFix: Select the parent and opt-out policy, then carry the parent through CLI and app creation and expose the effective model to child rows.
2836.caveats: The CLI behavior was reproduced directly twice. The app handoff and model-list behavior were verified from the trusted source path.
